# fontkit — MIT License

`fontkit.umd.min.js` is the official browser build of `@pdf-lib/fontkit`
(npm package `@pdf-lib/fontkit`, version 1.1.1 — the fontkit fork maintained
by the pdf-lib project, itself derived from Devon Govett's original
`fontkit`), used here so `pdf-lib` can parse, subset, and embed the custom
TTF fonts in `fonts/` directly into exported PDFs. Distributed under the MIT
License, per the package's own `package.json` ("license": "MIT").
